info.title: PennyATS API
info.description:
The public REST API for PennyATS. Generated from the code by `pnpm api:spec`; do not edit by hand.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. An admin creates keys in Settings > API. A key acts as one user and can never do more than that user; its scopes narrow it further. Interviewer keys only see jobs their user is on the hiring team for, and scorecards stay hidden until their user has submitted their own.

Lists are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`; follow `next_cursor` until it is null. Errors always look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

Every write is recorded in the audit log with the key as actor. Send `X-PennyATS-Agent: <name>` from AI agents so their actions show as agent activity.

Application.description: One candidate's application to one job.

Candidate.description: A person. Emails are stored lowercased and are unique.

applications.description: Only applications on jobs the key's user can see.

job_id.description: The job to apply them to. They start in its first stage.

email.description: Reuses the existing candidate when the email is already known.

source.description: Where they came from, for the sources report. Defaults to the key's source label, then API.

CreateJob.description: New jobs get the default pipeline stages.

EmailDraft.description: A rendered template. Nothing is sent or recorded.

EmailResult.description: Every attempt is recorded on the candidate's timeline, including failed and skipped ones.

Error.description: Every error response has this shape. `code` is stable; `message` is for people.

Interview.description: Status is derived from the schedule and submitted scorecards.

Job.description: A job. Compensation and internal notes are not exposed through the API yet.

source.description: Source given to candidates this key adds, unless the request sets one.

role.description: Role preset key, such as `recruiter` or `hiring_manager`.

Me.description: The key making the request and the user it acts as.

Report.description: The same table the Reports page and its CSV download show.

reason.description: Required to reject: one of "Does not meet minimum qualifications", "Not enough relevant experience", "Technical skills gap", "Did not pass assessment", "Communication", "Values or team alignment", "Overqualified", "Work authorization or eligibility", "Location or relocation mismatch", "Compensation mismatch", "Potentially fraudulent application", "Duplicate application", "Unresponsive", "Candidate withdrew interest", "Accepted another offer", "Hired another candidate", "Position filled", "Position closed or on hold", "Other". Free text for withdrawn.

note.description: Optional note stored with a rejection reason.

Stage.description: A pipeline stage. Applications move through a job's stages in `position` order.

interview_id.description: Omit for a stage-level scorecard on the current stage.

ratings.description: Attribute name to rating, 1 to 4. Names must be the interview's or job's scorecard attributes.

SubmitScorecard.description: Submitting again for the same interview (or stage) edits the earlier scorecard.

scheduled_at.description: When it starts, with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-12-03T17:00:00Z. Must be in the future.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the time was chosen in, e.g. America/New_York. Required with scheduled_at.

meeting_location.description: Room, address, or an http(s) meeting link.

state.description: Mark held, cancel, or restore a cancelled interview.

UpdateInterview.description: Schedule or reschedule (checked against the interviewers' other interviews), or change its state. Same as the candidate profile.

UpdateJob.description: Only the fields you send change.

x-scopes.description: List and view jobs the key's user can see
Add applications, move stages, hire, reject, withdraw, reopen
Read scorecards (hidden until the key's user submits their own, as in the app)
Submit scorecards as the key's user
Add, schedule, complete, cancel, and restore interviews
List email templates and draft emails from them

x-webhooks.description: Someone applied, or a candidate was added to a job.
An application moved to another stage.
A scorecard was submitted or edited.
